Vacancy for RSO
Tuesday, 12 August 2025
1609 Hits
Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram Dist. Wardha (MS) invites applications for the post of
Medical Physicist cum RSO (Open-1)
in the prescribed proforma (available on website: www.mgims.ac.in). The application along with all certified photocopies of academic and experience certificates should reach to the office of the Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram, Dist. Wardha- 442102
latest by 30/08/2025.
Qualification & Experience:
The candidate must have M.Sc. in Medical Physics OR MSc in Physics with Diploma in Radiological/Medical physics from BARC or from AERB recognized university/institution with minimum 12 months of internship in a recognized radiation therapy department. Person with 2 years’ experience in the Radiotherapy Department in a Medical College, will be preferred. He/ She should also have a Radiological Safety Officer (RSO) certificate.
Please click here to download the form
Salary
:
As admissible under the rules of Kasturba Health Society.
Age: Between 18-38 years for open category/ between 18-43 years for reserved category.
Note:
1) The application so received shall be screened by the Society and shortlisted candidatesshall be
intimated about the date, time and place.
2) Age and experience can be relaxed for exceptional and deserving candidate.
3) Society reserves the right related to selection or appointment.
4) No TA and DA will be paid by Kasturba Health Society for attending the interview.
5) Decision of Selection Committee will be final.
SECRETARY
Swachhata Pakhwada - 2025
Swachhata Pakwada September 2024
